_how: Daily config template. Copy to configs/YYYY-MM-DD.json and set date. Run tools/cover_facts.py to fill the cover facts (wx*, t10*, sunset, spokenWeather). Fill the board slots from that day's script only, and fill deal.verdict with the real call (Pick, Consider, Wait or Pass); a production build refuses a missing or invalid verdict. Leave titleAlign as center (approved default).
fine: Educational commentary. Not advice. Opinions of Raphael Kammer.
